decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming-material know-how for dental labs, so the firm can read market feedback well and refine the line with its own R&D.
A PETG thermoforming blank sits at the centre of the firm's established blank and thermoforming expertise, giving it high absorptive capacity to improve the product and keep it in the range.

The UV-curing lacquer fits the firm's light-curing materials knowledge for digital and lab workflows, though its lower website visibility suggests it is a minor item at some risk of range consolidation.

Custom hearing protection earmolds draw on the firm's skilled custom-earmold manufacturing and digital production base, so it can learn from results and improve them, despite the sibling earmold line being withdrawn.
